```yaml
name: Careful Rebase Workflow

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up JDK 11
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '11'
        distribution: 'adopt'

    - name: Install Maven
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y maven

    - name: Run pre-rebase base-only improvement detection
      run: |
        # Identify base-only files
        git diff --name-only $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD > base-only-files.txt
        echo "Base-only files:"
        cat base-only-files.txt

    - name: Prompt for base-only protection policy
      id: base-only-policy
      run: |
        read -p "Do you want to protect base-only files? (yes/no): " response
        echo "::set-output name=answer::$response"

    - name: Apply base-only protection policy
      if: steps.base-only-policy.outputs.answer == 'yes'
      run: |
        # Implement policy logic here
        echo "Applying base-only protection policy..."
        # Example: Use a tool or script to handle base-only files

    - name: Run post-rebase regression scan
      run: |
        # Scan for unintended net deletions
        git diff --stat $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD
        # Additional checks can be added here

    - name: Commit changes
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
      with:
        commit_message: "chore(i18n): add regression detection to careful-rebase workflow"
        branch: main
        commit_options: "--no-verify"
```
